fusions.name: Scatter the Flock
fusions.desc: A splashing rush that deals 11 water damage to every enemy within 3 tiles, knocks them back 3 tiles and leaves them [Soaked] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Painted Decoy
fusions.desc: Hurls a wooden decoy that deals 28 damage to the first enemy it meets, then bursts, hitting every enemy within 3.5 tiles for 80% of that. The target has a 40% chance to be turned against its allies for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Tolling Caper
fusions.desc: Increases your dodge chance by 25% for 10 seconds, and pulls up to 4 enemies within 5 tiles onto you for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Off the Back
fusions.desc: Each condition laid on you has a 20% chance to be sent back to whoever inflicted it.
